capabilities: Synchronize date properties between notes and a Markwhen timeline file
Group and sort timeline events by note properties
Filter which notes sync using required tags
Expand month-only or year-only dates to full date ranges
Toggle synchronization from a sidebar button
disambiguation: Not a cross-device vault sync; 'sync' here means keeping note date properties in step with a Markwhen timeline file.
extras: The README links to a Medium article for more information; required tags currently cannot be left empty, which the author says will be changed.
problem: Notes with date properties cannot be visualized as a timeline without manually maintaining a separate Markwhen timeline file by hand.

relations.evidence: Synchronize Properties from your Obsidian notes with Markwhen timeline files.
The format of the properties for the dates in the notes are based on the format from Full Calendar

summary: Syncs date properties between Obsidian notes and a Markwhen timeline (.mw) file, with grouping, sorting, filtering, and optional bidirectional syncing.
